features.name: Get Started
features.description: Complete first-run setup by tapping Get Started and allowing storage or media permissions.
actions: Tap Get Started on the first-run screen
Allow storage, music, or media permissions if a system dialog appears

features.name: Play song
features.description: Start playback by tapping a song in the library list.
actions: Tap a song in the library or song list so it starts playing

features.name: Open Currently Playing
features.description: Open the now-playing screen from the bottom playing card.
actions: Tap the bottom playing card (mini player) to open the currently playing screen

features.name: Pause Song
features.description: Open the now-playing screen from the bottom card and pause playback.
actions: Tap the bottom playing card to open the currently playing screen

features.name: Next song
features.description: Open the now-playing screen from the bottom card and skip to the next track.
actions: Tap the bottom playing card to open the currently playing screen

features.name: Previous song
features.description: Open the now-playing screen from the bottom card and go to the previous track.
actions: Tap the bottom playing card to open the currently playing screen

features.name: Search
features.description: Open search and type a query to find music in the library.

features.name: Rescan library
features.description: Open the navigation drawer and rescan the music library from the confirmation dialog.
actions: Tap the hamburger menu on the left to open the navigation drawer
Tap Rescan on the confirmation dialog

features.name: Shuffle All
features.description: Open the overflow menu and start shuffle-all playback.
actions: Tap the 3-dot overflow menu on the right
